## 逐操作查看张量约束: ## Inspect tensor constraints operation by operation
在 Neumann 原理或静态磁电课堂中，可以把一个完整参考复制到原实验，再手动: In the Neumann-principle or static magnetoelectric lesson, copy a complete reference into the original experiment and run it manually. The calculation center also offers an optional constraint replay. Old records and calculations without replay retain their original result format.
回放首先声明有序的内禀分量和基矩阵。对称介电张量用 `(xx,xy,xz,yy,: The replay first declares the ordered intrinsic components and basis matrices. A symmetric dielectric tensor uses six coordinates `(xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz)`; a general static magnetoelectric tensor uses nine, without an imposed transpose symmetry. Select a generator and a column to connect the actual transformation of a basis matrix with a representation-matrix column, then inspect one row of `(D(g)−I)t=0`.
原求解器计算生成元约束的精确零空间。回放显示约束矩阵、精确 RREF、主元和基向: The original solver computes the exact nullspace of the generator constraints. The replay displays the constraint matrix, exact RREF, pivots and basis vectors. For a completed finite closure, `P=Σ_g D(g)/|G|` independently checks the allowed subspace. Enumeration retains at most 96 time-tagged operations. Reaching the bound without completing closure does not prove that the group is infinite; the original nullspace calculation remains usable.
六分量对称坐标不是单位长度的 Frobenius 正交基：`G=diag(1,2: The six symmetric-component basis matrices are orthogonal in the Frobenius inner product but are not all unit length: `G=diag(1,2,2,1,2,1)`. The group average therefore satisfies `P²=P`, `AP=0` and `PᵀG=GP`; its coordinate matrix need not satisfy `Pᵀ=P`. The editable seed is used for numerical projection exercises. Allowed coefficients and actual material constants are distinct objects.
沿 `C2(z)→C4(z)→O` 比较静态对称介电张量，允许维数依次为 4、2: Along `C2(z)→C4(z)→O`, the allowed dimensions of the static symmetric dielectric tensor are 4, 2 and 1. Separate magnetoelectric counterexamples generated by i, 1′ and i′ have dimensions 0, 0 and 9. A zero seed always projects to zero; permission does not require a component to be nonzero. The original orientation control rotates an already allowed tensor into laboratory coordinates; it does not add a crystal symmetry operation.
这一回放覆盖静态对称介电和一般静态磁电二阶张量。原有弹性与压电计算保留，但不把它: This replay covers static symmetric dielectric and general static magnetoelectric rank-two tensors. Existing elasticity and piezoelectric calculations remain available, without a claimed operation replay. Transport, dissipation and frequency-dependent response require their respective transformation rules.
精确回放首批支持静态对称介电张量和一般静态线性磁电张量；原有张量计算结果保留。: The exact replay supports static symmetric dielectric and general static linear magnetoelectric tensors. The original tensor calculation is retained.
有界闭包尝试需要超过96个带时间标记的操作，未认证有限群；这不是无限群的证明，原: The bounded closure attempt would require more than 96 time-tagged operations, so a finite group was not certified. This does not prove an infinite group; the original generator-constraint calculation remains valid.
精确生成元约束与已闭合有限群平均相互核验；数值副本用于展示，不替代精确矩阵。: The exact generator constraints and completed finite-group average independently agree. Numerical mirrors support the display; the exact matrices remain authoritative.
精确回放内部恒等式核验未通过；原有张量计算结果保留。: The replay's internal exact-identity checks did not pass. The original tensor calculation is retained.
